handle.description: R-Universe sub-domain (typically the GitHub user or org that owns <handle>.r-universe.dev).

name.description: Display name as it appears in the package's Author/Maintainer field. Used to confirm the registrant is an aut/cre before a package is synced; falls back to the R-Ladies directory entry when omitted.

directory_id.description: Optional slug of the corresponding entry in the R-Ladies directory.
